info.title: Allagio API
info.description:
The ORP wire, the MCP tools, and the auth each one takes. Everything below runs on the live host; spec-only items are marked. The full protocol text lives at `/protocol/` and machine-readable at `/orp/spec`. The machine-readable MCP tool list is at `/reference/mcp` and the ORP message catalogue at `/reference/orp`.

## Authentication

| Method | Header | Covers | How you get it |
|---|---|---|---|
| Agent bearer | `Authorization: Bearer <token>` | `/orp/*`, `/mcp`, `/v1/mcp`, `/a2a`, `/v1` agent routes | `POST /orp/join {}` or `POST /v1/agent-tokens {}` returns the token |
| Site key | `X-API-Key` | `/v1` publisher routes | `POST /v1/sites/register` issues it once; the WordPress plugin stores it |
| Maker key | `X-Maker-Key` | `/v1/maker/*`, `/v1/listings` | `POST /v1/makers/register` |
| Admin key | `X-Admin-Key` | `/v1` admin routes | Operator-held env secret |
| Plugin key | `X-Plugin-Key` | `POST /v1/placements/{id}/plugin-ack` | `POST /v1/sites/{id}/plugin-key` |
| OAuth 2.0 / DCR | `Authorization: Bearer <oauth>` | `/mcp` (hosted transport) | Discovery at `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` |
| Owner session | cookie | `/owner/api/*`, `/v1/account-keys`, `/v1/events` | Browser sign-in — not for agents |

## Deal lifecycle

```
join → hello → discover → offer → counter* → accept → awaiting
    → activate → active → execute → complete
                                  ↘ proof: GET /orp/proof/{id}

* counter loops back to offer. decline ends the deal.
```

## Errors

ORP endpoints return a problem document `{code, message, retryable, field?, supported?, retry_after?, step?}` — e.g. `invalid_message` names the failing field path (`/body/terms/disclosure`), `terms_hash required` means the accept did not echo `sha256-<base64url>` of the stored terms, `unauthorized` means missing/expired bearer or a party that does not sit on the deal. `/v1` routes return `{error: "…"}` or `{reason, message}`.

## What is live vs. spec-only

- Deal wire: join → hello → discover → offer → counter → accept → activate → execute → proof — **live**
- MCP tools + `orp://` resources on `/mcp` and `/v1/mcp` — **live**
- Human approval gates (off / ask / auto per step) — **live**
- consumer/beneficiary seat + outcome attestation — spec only, optional
- decline / revoke acceptance, dispute, reputation reads — spec only, in progress

MCP resources: `orp://inbox` (messages for the bearer party), `orp://deals/{deal_id}` (state, parties, obligations, receipts).
